response.query: What cost disaggregation, probabilistic uncertainty, life-cycle maintenance, and spare-part lead-time data are essential to make procurement resilient?
response.answer: To make procurement resilient, cost disaggregation, probabilistic uncertainty analysis, life-cycle maintenance costs, and accurate spare-part lead-time data are essential. These elements help in risk management and strategic planning.
